name: The Barrow King
summary: Solomon Roderick says every grave he ever cut a stone for has opened. The Barrow King holds his throne of skulls below.

closes.when: flag.moonfall_started and flag.moonfall_nights_left <= 0 and not flag.moonfall_fled

stages.journal: The graves of Maidenmist are opening, and the living weaken by the hour. A nameless king with an army of wights has woken beneath the royal barrow.
stages.hint: Ask around the region for how to find it: its hook-giver, and the one who knows its secret.

stages.journal: We found where The Barrow King lairs. There may be a way to hurt it more than the usual.
stages.hint: Learn its weakness from the one who knows it, or go straight to its lair.

stages.journal: We carry what hurts The Barrow King. Time to go to its lair.
The Barrow King is dead. The moon's gaze moves to the Drowned Crossroads.
The nights ran out before it fell.
